errors.text_span: einen hellvioletten Balken, der den gesetzlichen Mindestlohn darstellt, und einen dunkleren violetten Balken, der 60 % des Medianlohns von Vollzeitbeschäftigten darstellt
errors.evidence: The description swaps the colors: the legal minimum wage is shown in blue, not light violet, and 60% of the median wage is shown in purple, not dark violet.

The description incorrectly assigns the color 'hellvioletten' to the legal minimum wage and 'dunkleren violetten' to 60% of the median wage, but the figure shows blue for the legal minimum wage and purple for 60% of the median wage.
The description incorrectly lists the values for the legal minimum wage (blue bars). The correct values are: 8.50, 8.50, 8.84, 8.85, 9.19, 9.35, 9.55, 10.52, 12.00, 12.41, and 12.82.

errors.text_span: 60 % des Medianlohns von Vollzeitbeschäftigten beginnen bei 8,50 € im Jahr 2015 und steigen auf 12,41 €, 12,82 € im Jahr 2025
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly lists the starting value for 60% of the median wage as 8.50 € in 2015, but the correct value is 10.59 €. The values for 2024 and 2025 are also swapped and incorrect (14.69 and 15.12 instead of 14.69 and 14.12).
The description does not mention the dashed feature of the purple bars for the years 2024 and 2025.
The description does not explicitly state the y-axis scale intervals (2-Euro increments).
The description lists values in a confusing order that does not correspond to the chronological sequence of years.

errors.text_span: Die vertikale Achse ist mit „Angaben in Euro pro Stunde“ beschriftet und stellt einen linearen Wertebereich von 0 bis 16 dar, wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen in einem Intervall von 2 erfolgen.
errors.evidence: The phrasing is awkward and redundant. The reference description states this more clearly.
